title: New Scenery & Airports in MSFS Marketplace ✈️🌍 | Weekly Update | Week 37
description:
🔍 Description
🚀 Discover the latest enhancements in Microsoft Flight Simulator! ✨ This week, the MSFS Marketplace has added stunning new scenery and airports, including water fixes for 2 US cities, Brasilia Landmarks and the Munster Osnabruck Airport (EDDG). 🏞️🛫 Join us as we explore these breathtaking additions and see how they elevate your flight simulation experience. Don’t miss out on the latest updates and improvements!

📹 Other marketplace additions
If you are looking for either the new training missions or new aircrafts and liveries review the respective video by clicking on one if the links below:
